population: SHA256-canonical transcripts only; all source paths retained separately
normalization: lowercase alphanumeric; supported equal-length book aliases applied only in derived comparison text

thresholds.FULL_TEXT: cosine>=.76 and shorter/longer length>=.6 and ordered SequenceMatcher ratio>=.65
thresholds.STORY_PASSAGE: longest contiguous normalized common substring>=80 and (cosine>=.45 or common/shorter>=.3)

cluster_method: connected components per edge type; transitive membership does not imply all pairs meet threshold
passage_caveat: Common paragraph may be a generic CTA; semantic story identity requires A/manual review
